verses.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
But God setteth out his love toward us, seeing that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
For the wages of sin is death: but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God.
Neither is there salvation in any other: for among men there is given none other Name under heaven, whereby we must be saved.
